source: Synthetic input recipe, no manufacturer or native CAD dimensions

expression_language.derived_references: bare names defined in ordered derived entries
expression_language.evaluation: recursive arrays and dictionaries; derived entries in order; select evaluates selected branch only

semantics.select: if args0 then args1 else args2
semantics.permute_dimensions: args0 is [x,y,z], args1 is permutation of XYZ; return dimensions in character order

input_validation.count_reason: Frozen 37-role recipe defines two devices and two dividers; other device counts require a manifest revision

scenario_contract.resized_dimension: For scenario.operation=resize use target_plywood_external[axis]; otherwise default. Validate finite dimensions. Recompute B, internal as [W-2*T,D-2*T,H-2*T], and external datums; preserve local compartment box dimensions/centers.
scenario_contract.approved_group_edge_offset: Use explicitly approved persisted whole-group parameter from previous observation if present, otherwise default; unilateral member edits are conflicts.
scenario_contract.resize_preserves: device/accessory/divider local layout; whole-group approved overrides

reconcile.manual_overrides: Validated whole-group changes from scenario.manual_overrides; preserve approval IDs in observation.preserved_manual_approvals and carry decisions through previous on resize

manual_additions.membership: supplied reviewed group and unique physical id; include in inventory and transport bounds

reconcile.manual_approval: Nonempty explicit scenario approval and approved group scope required; synthetic test tokens are not production authorization

coordinate_rules.frames: rotation columns are local u/v/n in closed XYZ; P = origin + rotation * uvn
coordinate_rules.occurrence_rotation: rotation entries name proper local-part-to-closed matrices; list means one name per slot
coordinate_rules.local_bounds: centered_box_from_shape means min=-shape/2, max=shape/2 in catalog axes; rigid definitions use catalog literals
coordinate_rules.interior_origin: Internal layout origin coincides with closed origin in this synthetic contract; do not add panel thickness
coordinate_rules.panel_planes: Synthetic panels straddle mounting planes by thickness/2; these are envelope test boxes, not production joinery
coordinate_rules.slot_ids: group_id + / + one_based_slot_index; list order is stable

SYNTHETIC-CONSTRUCTOR-APPROVAL-1.permits: Local compartment centers rather than global case symmetry; no waiver of member completeness, proper rotation, or accounting

SYNTHETIC-CORNER-FUNCTION-APPROVAL-1.permits: Single front-right functional corner handle in stable dedicated local frame; ordinary handles retain wall symmetry

SYNTHETIC-B-HANDLE-APPROVAL.scope: whole-group handle pattern; preserve after resize

SYNTHETIC-C-ANCHOR-APPROVAL.scope: one rigid synthetic-20-cube with closed W/2,D/2,base_height/4 anchor; preserve after resize

fit_and_allowances.other_footprints: Require finite positive shapes, fixed approved catalog geometry and valid anchor domains; detailed contact and cutout clearances are outside this recipe
fit_and_allowances.interior_containment: Layout envelope boxes must fit internal, without positive overlap between device/accessory/divider boxes; foam/custom/import are symbolic test insert roles allowed to share local placement, not a production collision claim
approved_contacts: paired closure profiles share seam plane
paired latch/hinge half mounting points coincide
wheel and socket share X/Y only

transport_envelope.proof_scope: synthetic transport AABB only; no collision or structural proof
